title: Check your resume through the eyes of an AI recruiter in 1 minute
subtitle: Upload your resume — get an AI review and first matching jobs without signing up.

upload.title: Upload resume
upload.sourceLabel: How would you like to provide your resume?

file.hint: PDF or DOCX, up to 5 MB

linkedin.label: LinkedIn profile URL
linkedin.hint: Reading LinkedIn profiles is not available yet. Upload a PDF/DOCX or select Text and paste your profile details for analysis.

options.home: A new job in my country

consent.text: I consent to resume processing and sharing its contents with the external AI service OpenRouter and its selected provider for analysis. Our platform retains source data for up to 24 hours.

errors.invalidFormat: Invalid file format. Only PDF and DOCX are supported.
errors.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is 5 MB.
errors.emptyFile: The file is empty. Upload another file or paste text.
errors.invalidLinkedinUrl: Could not parse the LinkedIn URL. Check the link or upload a file/text.
errors.missingConsent: Consent to personal data processing is required.

timeout.title: Analysis is taking longer than expected
timeout.message: We couldn't finish the review within 60 seconds. Try again — no need to re-upload the file.

analysis.slow: The review is taking more than a minute. Processing continues; no need to upload again.

errors.not_configured: The AI service is not configured yet. Please try later.
errors.free_model_required: No free model could be selected. Please try later.
errors.provider_limit: The AI request limit has been reached. Please try later.
errors.provider_balance: The AI service balance is insufficient. Please contact the administrator.
errors.provider_unavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try later.
errors.provider_request_rejected: The AI service rejected the request. Try pasting your resume text; if this persists, contact the administrator.
errors.provider_model_unavailable: The AI model is unavailable. Contact the administrator to check the configuration.
errors.pdf_page_limit: PDFs without a complete text layer support up to 3 pages. Upload DOCX or paste your resume text.
errors.invalid_ai_response: The AI returned an incomplete or invalid result. Please retry the analysis.
errors.unreadable_file: Unable to read the resume. Upload a text-based PDF or DOCX, or paste at least 30 characters of resume text.
errors.invalid_file: Please upload a valid PDF or DOCX file.
errors.invalid_goal: Check your goal, country and processing consent.
errors.analysis_busy: Other resumes are being processed. Please try shortly.
errors.analysis_rate_limit: Limit reached: 5 analysis starts per hour. Please try later.
errors.analysis_not_found: The analysis was not found or has expired. Please upload your resume again.
errors.analysis_forbidden: This analysis belongs to another account.
errors.analysis_not_ready: The analysis is not ready yet. Return to the progress screen.
errors.source_expired: The source file has expired. Please upload your resume again.
errors.server_restarted: The server restarted during processing. Retry without uploading again.
errors.analysis_timeout: The previous attempt timed out. Retry without uploading your file again.
errors.network_error: Unable to reach the server. Checking the connection.
errors.download_unavailable: File saving is unavailable on this device.
errors.processing_failed: Unable to complete this operation. Please retry.
errors.linkedin_unsupported: Upload a PDF/DOCX or paste your resume text.

preview.title: Resume analysis preview
preview.subtitle: Your resume score, key issues and first matching jobs.
preview.unlock: Unlock full analysis and all jobs
preview.confirmLocation: Confirm with the employer whether remote work from your target country is allowed.
